title: Philly Cheesesteak
description: Philly Cheesesteak is a dish from United States prepared with beef ribeye, yellow onion, green bell pepper, bread roll. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Ordinary bread rolls replace long Philly-style hoagie rolls.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 9 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 4 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
